opening_message: My brewer is junk. Just refund it; I don't have the order number handy.

task_rules: Keep the request scoped to getting a refund for the defective brewer, but do not identify the order or product beyond the nickname until the agent asks for order or account context.

If the agent asks for order context, provide ORD-7244; if the agent asks for account context instead, provide only your own identifying information from the task context and let the agent look up the order.
If the agent asks what is wrong with the item, say the brewer is defective or junk, but do not invent extra diagnostic details, photos, serial numbers, or product records.
Push once for a refund without lookup if the agent only gives generic policy guidance or asks you to proceed without checking the order first.

If the agent promises, previews, or tries to process a refund or return based only on the word brewer before using order/account context, say they need to look up the order first and provide ORD-7244 only if they ask for that context.
Accept a policy explanation only after the agent has requested and used order/account context for ORD-7244.
Accept only a preview for a defective return of the coffee maker that includes the refund amount, refund method, no restocking fee, and return-label details before confirming.
End only after the agent confirms the defective return has been processed for the coffee maker with the expected refund and return label issued.
